User.title: User
User.description: User profile containing synchronization settings, files list, background images and options.

accentColor.description: Hex color code for application accent customization.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Whether the navigation sidebar is collapsed.

profileImage.description: Base64 or URL string of user profile identity image.

backgroundImage.description: Custom main viewport background image reference.

selectedIndividualFiles.description: A list of individual files selected for synchronization.

trashedFiles.description: Files moved to internal trash bin.

parsedCache.description: Cached parsed agenda files text and schedule outputs.

importGoogleCalendar.description: Whether to import events from Google Calendar.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating last user update synchronized from client.

ScheduleItem.title: ScheduleItem
ScheduleItem.description: An individual schedule activity item details.

startTime.description: Time string when the activity begins (HH:MM format).

endTime.description: Time string when the activity ends (HH:MM format).

activity.description: Name or title of the schedule activity.

instructions.description: Contextual instructions or description for the activity.

sourceFile.description: Origin filename for the schedule item.

ActivityCustomization.title: ActivityCustomization
ActivityCustomization.description: Custom objectives and checklists assigned to a schedule activity block.

objective.description: Overall objective for this activity protocol.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User feedback given at the end of an activity period.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary settings and user details document.

/users/{userId}/schedule/current.description: Schedule elements belonging to the specific user.

/users/{userId}/customizations/{customiz.description: Tailored objectives and checklists associated with specific schedule actions.
